toolsPreview.name: create_list
toolsPreview.description: Turn your movie/TV recommendations into a playable trailer page on zinema.tv and share the link with the user. Each title plays as a full trailer the user can scroll, like a personal cinema session. Links are permanent and free. Returns per-title resolution (echo of what matched, so you can catch mix-ups) and playability. Use it whenever you recommend movies or shows: a page that PLAYS beats a text list.

toolsPreview.name: get_list
toolsPreview.description: Check a zinema list you created earlier: which titles play now. A title that was 'pending' may have become 'playable' (its trailer gets acquired automatically) or 'no_trailer' (none exists anywhere).
